description: The questions and answers published on the PolarJay website. Optionally filtered by words in the question or the answer.

limit.description: How many questions to return, default 10. count is the total that match.

locale.description: Answer language: es, en. Default en. A regional form such as en-US is read as en. A language the site does not publish is rejected with the list of the ones it does.

query.description: Words to look for, for example parking, pets or breakfast

name: list_faq
title: Frequently asked questions
